                    value_name='Yield Increase (%)')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="pastel")

line_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df_melted,
    x='Month',
    y='Yield Increase (%)',
    hue='Technology and Region',
    style='Technology and Region',
    markers=True
)

line_plot.set_title('Monthly Yield Increase by Agricultural Technology and Region', pad=20, fontsize=16)
line_plot.set_xlabel('Month', labelpad=10, fontsize=12)
line_plot.set_ylabel('Yield Increase (%)', labelpad=10, fontsize=12)

plt.legend(['Precision Soil Prep (North)', 'Precision Soil Prep (South)', 'Automated Irrigation (North)', 'Automated Irrigation (South)', 'Smart Planting (North)', 'Smart Planting (South)'], title='Technology and Region', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
plt.tight_layout()

SUMMARY
 This image is a line chart titled "Monthly Yield Increase by Agricultural Technology and Region," which illustrates the percentage increase in agricultural yield over the course of a year, segmented by different technologies and regions. The chart features six distinct lines, each representing a combination of a specific agricultural technology and region, with each data point plotted monthly from January to December.

The x-axis is labeled "Month" and spans the twelve months of the year, while the y-axis, labeled "Yield Increase (%)", ranges from 8% to 18%. Each line is color-coded and accompanied by a unique marker style to differentiate between the technologies and regions. The legend on the right clarifies these distinctions: Precision Soil Prep (North) is shown in blue, Precision Soil Prep (South) in orange, Smart Planting (North) in green, Smart Planting (South) in red, Automated Irrigation (North) in purple, and Automated Irrigation (South) in brown.

Observing the trends, Smart Planting (North) consistently shows the highest yield increase, peaking at 17.2% in August and never falling below 15.0%. Smart Planting (South) follows, with values ranging between 13.2% and 14.8%. Precision Soil Prep (North) and Precision Soil Prep (South) display moderate increases, with the northern region generally outperforming the southern region, peaking at 15.0% and 12.6%, respectively. Automated Irrigation shows the lowest yield increases, with the northern region reaching up to 15.5% and the southern region peaking at 14.0%. Notably, all technologies exhibit a general upward trend early in the year, peaking around mid-year, and then showing some variability towards the end of the year.

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

source = Path("chart.py").read_text()
source = source.replace("sns.scatterplot(", "sns.lineplot(")
source = source.replace("    markers=True\n", "    markers=True,\n    dashes=False,\n    sort=False\n")
source = source.replace("plt.legend(['Precision Soil Prep (North)', 'Precision Soil Prep (South)', 'Automated Irrigation (North)', 'Automated Irrigation (South)', 'Smart Planting (North)', 'Smart Planting (South)'],", "line_plot.set_ylim(8, 18)\n\nplt.legend(")
Path("chart.py").write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))

table = pd.read_csv("table.csv")
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(df, table)
ax = plt.gca()
print("Axis limits:", ax.get_ylim())
print("Title:", ax.get_title())
print("Legend:", [t.get_text() for t in ax.get_legend().get_texts()])
for line in ax.lines[:6]:
    print("Series:", line.get_color(), line.get_marker(), line.get_linestyle(), list(line.get_ydata()))
